macros.name: alt
macros.doc: The \alt macro moves us to a new line, and typesets a vertical bar in the margin.

macros.name: grammarindent
macros.doc: \grammarindent is the amount by which the right hand side of a production rule is indented from the left margin.

macros.name: lit
macros.doc: display literal text, which the reader should type directly, using the \lit command.

macros.name: sdendspace
macros.doc: \sdendspace The length of the rule between the last item on a line and the arrow at the very end.

macros.name: sdfinalskip
macros.doc: \sdfinalskip The length of the rule which finishes the last line of a syntax diagram.

macros.name: sdlengths
macros.doc: \sdlengths sets the values of the length parameters used by the environment based on the current text size.

macros.name: sdmidskip
macros.doc: \sdmidskip The length of the rule on either side of a large construction (either a stack or a rep).

macros.name: sdrulewidth
macros.doc: \sdrulewidth Half the width of the rules used in the diagram.

macros.name: sdsize
macros.doc: The \sdsize command sets the default type size for the environment: this is normally \small.

macros.name: sdstartspace
macros.doc: \sdstartspace The length of the rule between the arrows which begin each line of the syntax diagram and the first item on the line.

macros.name: sdtokskip
macros.doc: \sdtokskip The length of the rule on either side of a \tok item or syntax abbreviation.

macros.name: shortverb
macros.doc: You can set up a character as a ‘verbatim shorthand’ character using the \shortverb command.

macros.name: synt
macros.doc: The \synt macro typesets its argument as a syntactic quantity.

macros.name: syntax
macros.doc: The \syntax macro typesets its argument, allowing the use of our shortcuts within the argument.

macros.name: tok
macros.doc: The argument of this command is typeset in LaTeX’s LR mode and inserted into the diagram.

macros.name: underscore
macros.doc: The \underscore macro typesets an underline character, using a horizontal rule.

envs.name: rep
envs.doc: Text which can be repeated is enclosed in a rep environment: the text is displayed with a backwards pointing arrow drawn over it, showing that it may be repeated.
